title: Income tax provision — Keystone Manufacturing
instructions: Prepare Keystone Manufacturing's Year 2 income tax provision. The enacted federal rate is **21%** for all years; ignore state taxes. There is no valuation allowance.

exhibits.title: Book-tax differences, Year 2
exhibits.content:
Pretax financial (book) income: **$1,500,000**.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Municipal bond interest included in book income | 40,000 |
| Fines paid to a regulator (expensed for books) | 15,000 |
| Tax depreciation in excess of book depreciation | 120,000 |
| Bad debt expense (book) in excess of write-offs (tax) | 30,000 |
| Rent received in advance for Year 3 (taxable when received) | 60,000 |
| Installment-sale gain recognized for books, taxable in future years | 80,000 |

exhibits.title: Deferred tax balances, January 1, Year 2
exhibits.content:
- Deferred tax liability: **$21,000** (cumulative taxable temporary differences of $100,000)
- Deferred tax asset: **$4,200** (cumulative deductible temporary differences of $20,000)

rows.label: Excess tax depreciation
rows.explanation: Future taxable amounts when book depreciation exceeds tax later.

rows.label: Bad debt expense in excess of write-offs
rows.explanation: Deductible later when accounts are written off.

rows.label: Rent received in advance
rows.explanation: Already taxed; future book revenue won't be taxed again.

parts.prompt: Record the Year 2 income tax provision in one entry.
parts.explanation: Expense 309,750 and DTA increase 18,900 (debits) = taxes payable 286,650 + DTL increase 42,000 (credits) = 328,650.
